items.title: SYY Q2 Deep Dive: AI-Driven Productivity and Restaurant Depot Acquisition Shape Outlook
items.summary: Food distribution giant Sysco (NYSE:SYY) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 4.7% year on year to $22.12 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.53 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
